library Lights

    //==
    // # ILightSource
    //
    // A scene light whose sole interface member is the shadow-casting flag.

    // True when the light contributes shadows; a readable spelling of CastsShadows.
    IsShadowCaster(self: ILightSource): Boolean
        => self.CastsShadows;

    IsShadowless(self: ILightSource): Boolean
        => self.CastsShadows.Not;
